page_title: TOU 1-0 REI | Toulouse v Reims 03/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Today's match ends for Zakaria Aboukhlal who will be replaced by Frank Magri (Toulouse).
90+3' Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle as Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
90+1' Junya Ito (Reims) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' Luka Elsner has decided to make a change. Niama Sissoko (Reims) replaces Oumar Diakite.
90' Substitution. Amadou Kone leaves the pitch and is replaced by Mohamed Aboubakar Bamba (Reims).
90' Cedric Kipre (Reims) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the top of the net but Guillaume Restes keeps it out.
87' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
86' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
86' Luka Elsner decides to make a substitution. Joseph Okumu will be replaced by Mamadou Diakhon (Reims).
84' 1 - 0 Goal! A great through ball by Gabriel Suazo sets up Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the right side of the goal. 1:0.
84' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) sends a chip pass into the box, but Yehvann Diouf is quickest to intercept the ball.
81' What was Nhoa Sangui (Reims) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
81' Keito Nakamura (Reims) leaps high to meet a lofted pass around the penalty spot, but his header crashes against the crossbar!
80' Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle and it's Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
79' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
77' Keito Nakamura (Reims) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
77' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Toulouse, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
75' Oumar Diakite (Reims) quickly picks up the rebound and drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. The opponent's goalkeeper pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
73' Substitution. Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Warren Kamanzi walks off.
73' Carles Martinez prepares a substitution. Yann Gboho is replaced by Shavy Babicka (Toulouse).
73' We are about to witness a substitution. Nhoa Sangui (Reims) is replacing Yaya-Kader Fofana.

72' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but his attempt went well wide of the right post.
72' Corner kick. Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) is ready to send the ball into the box.
70' Mark McKenzie (Toulouse) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul.
68' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) took the corner.
68' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
67' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Yehvann Diouf.
66' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
66' The free kick from long range, taken by Toulouse, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
65' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
64' Mathieu Vernice interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Yaya-Kader Fofana (Reims).
58' A cross by Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
56' Cristian Casseres floats over the corner and Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) gets on the end of it, but his header from around the penalty spot sails well wide of the right post.
55' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
54' The corner is swung in but Toulouse can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
54' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) commits a foul and Mathieu Vernice immediately signals a free kick.
53' An attempted cross from Sergio Akieme (Reims) is cleared.
53' The referee blows his whistle as Mark McKenzie (Toulouse) was too aggressive in his challenge.
50' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
50' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
49' Joshua King picks out Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse), who makes a total mess of his shot from mid-range and sends the ball high over the bar.
48' Junya Ito (Reims) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
47' Flag up against Keito Nakamura (Reims). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.

46' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Mathieu Vernice with no other option than to blow for a foul.
46' Referee Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' The goalkeeper dives to deny Joshua King (Toulouse), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post.
45+4' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
45+4' Yaya-Kader Fofana (Reims) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.

45+1' Yehvann Diouf pulls off a fantastic save! Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the left post, but the effort is kept out.
45+1' Joshua King (Toulouse) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Mathieu Vernice has a clear sight and sees a foul from Joseph Okumu (Reims).
43' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) works the corner short.
43' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
42' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
41' The foul by Oumar Diakite (Reims) was seen by Mathieu Vernice who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
40' Joshua King (Toulouse) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Mathieu Vernice who sees an offensive foul.
39' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) but poses no threat.
38' Yaya-Kader Fofana (Reims) commits a foul during an attacking move.
36' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
35' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
34' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) trips an opposition player and Mathieu Vernice signals a foul.

33' That didn't go as planned! Junya Ito (Reims) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom right corner was too weak to get past Guillaume Restes, who easily kept it out.
33' Junya Ito (Reims) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
30' Junya Ito (Reims) is adjudged offside.
29' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
27' The linesman raises his flag. Junya Ito (Reims) is adjudged offside.
24' The game is interrupted now, Mark McKenzie (Toulouse) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
21' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) is penalised for a foul. Mathieu Vernice had a clear view and blows his whistle.
20' Reims failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
19' Sergio Akieme (Reims) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the left post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
19' Junya Ito (Reims) will take a corner kick.
18' Reims take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
17' Mathieu Vernice couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Keito Nakamura (Reims) and blew his whistle.
16' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
11' Joshua King (Toulouse) was too forceful with his tackle and Mathieu Vernice interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
7' Amadou Kone (Reims) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
6' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) makes a rough challenge and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Keito Nakamura (Reims) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Reims will have the kick-off.
